transcript:
Speaker A: हट जा यहाँ से गवार कहीं की! गार्ड ने धक्के मार के बाहर निकाल दिया... [Get out of here, you illiterate! The guard pushed me out. I was just asking for water. I cried so much that day. My daughter suggested I learn English so people would respect me. My name is Sushila, I collect garbage in Delhi. 30 days ago, a mall guard humiliated me. My daughter downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. I practiced 10 minutes daily, using the AI Coach which corrected me without judgment. 30 days later, I went back to the same mall and asked the guard in fluent English: 'Excuse me sir, could I please have a glass of water? I have been working outside and I am feeling quite dehydrated.' The guard was stunned, the manager brought me water and called me 'madam'. Now I get respect. If I can do it, so can you. Download the English Seekho app and take the 30-day challenge.]
Speaker B: इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A garbage collector shares her story of being humiliated by a mall guard for asking for water. Motivated by her daughter, she uses the English Seekho app's AI Coach for 30 days to learn fluent English. She returns to the mall, speaks English, and earns immediate respect, prompting viewers to download the app and take the 30-day challenge.
